ix.title: Indexing, DOI and ISSN
ix.intro: What makes the journal findable in Google Scholar and research indexes, and gives each article a permanent DOI link. Most of it works by itself; the steps below show what is done and what is left.
ix.scholarText: Every article page carries the details Google Scholar reads (title, authors, date, journal, pages, PDF), and each PDF sits under its article's address, as Scholar requires. Scholar finds new journals by itself: there is no application. New articles usually appear within a few weeks.
ix.scholarArticles: {count, plural, =0 {No published articles yet} one {# published article carries Scholar details} other {# published articles carry Scholar details}}
ix.scholarSitemap: List of all pages for search engines (sitemap)
ix.scholarCheck: See what Google Scholar already shows from this site
ix.scholarConsole: To speed it up, add the sitemap in Google Search Console
ix.oaiText: These indexes collect articles from a standard address (OAI-PMH). Give them the address below once; after that they pick up new articles by themselves.
ix.base: — suggest the journal and paste the address.
ix.core: — submit the address on the “Join CORE” form.
ix.openaire: — sign in to PROVIDE and register the address.
ix.doaj: — the open access directory. Needs a confirmed ISSN and more than a year of publishing or at least 10 articles.
ix.auto: OpenAlex and Dimensions take articles from Crossref by themselves once DOIs are registered.
ix.issnHave: ISSN {issn} ({kind}): shown in the footer, on the home page, in the Google Scholar details and in Crossref.
ix.issnCheck: Check it in the ISSN Portal
ix.issnNone: The journal has no ISSN yet. DOAJ, Scopus and most indexes ask for one.
ix.issnS1Text: The ISSN centre checks that the journal already exists online, with its title, publisher and contacts.
ix.issnS2Text: The university applies as a legal entity, using the service “Davriy nashrlarga xalqaro standart (ISSN) raqamini berish”. The National Library of Uzbekistan issues it in about 5 working days. The fee is 836,000 so‘m.
ix.issnS3Text: The website is the online version. A printed version, if there is one, gets a separate number.
ix.issnS4Text: An admin types it in Settings. The site checks the number and shows it everywhere.
ix.doiText: A DOI is a permanent link to an article (https://doi.org/…) that never breaks, even if the site moves. Once set up, publishing an article gives it a DOI and registers it with Crossref.
ix.s1Text: Apply on crossref.org. For organisations in Uzbekistan it is free: Crossref's GEM programme waives the yearly fee and the fee per DOI. Crossref then sends a DOI prefix (10.xxxxx) and a login.
ix.s2: Type the DOI prefix in Settings
ix.s2Text: Open Settings and type the 10.xxxxx prefix
ix.s3Text: In Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables, add CROSSREF_USERNAME and CROSSREF_PASSWORD (type Secret), then redeploy. To try Crossref's test system first, also add CROSSREF_TEST = 1.
ix.s3Test: Connected to Crossref's test system: these DOIs are not live yet. Remove CROSSREF_TEST when the tests pass.
ix.s4Text: Each published article gets its DOI and is registered automatically. Results are checked every day; press “Check results” to see them sooner.
